schedule: New patch notes are posted every 1–2 weeks.
knownIssues: Lock Screen widgets may not appear on every macOS version. Turn them on in Settings › Desktop & Lock Screen and use “Preview: Lock Screen Now” to test.
Spotify now limits some features for small apps, so an artist's Popular songs come from Spotify search and may differ slightly from the Spotify app.
Connecting a Spotify account still needs a free Spotify developer app (Settings › Music Connections walks you through it).

items.text: Aquatic, Crystal and Classic glass styles for the island.
Word-by-word synced lyrics, a full-screen karaoke mode with a singing score, and Vinyl mode.
Desktop and Lock Screen widgets: now playing, clock, weather, calendar, battery and to-dos.
Spotify artist and album pages, Up Next, add to playlist and follow artists.
Tools tab: calculator and unit converter, color picker, Keep Awake, dark mode and more.
Focus modes, FaceTime calls, Caps Lock, Low Power and Wi-Fi alerts, just like iPhone.
One-click connecting for Spotify and Apple Music.
The Aries logo now appears in the menu bar.
Music Connections no longer shows Spotify as connected while asking you to connect it.
Artist and album pages now load when the full-screen player opens straight onto them.
Your Spotify sign-in is stored in a private file only your Mac account can read, so macOS no longer asks for your password after updates.
